title: hypericum acutum subsp. tetrapterum
intro: Hypericum acutum subsp. tetrapterum, commonly known as Four-winged St. John's Wort, is a plant species within the St. John's Wort genus. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its ability to treat anxiety, insomnia, and other nervous disorders due to its health benefits in promoting relaxation and reducing stress levels. The therapeutic actions of Four-winged St. John's Wort include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antibacterial properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include hyperforin and hypericin, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and contribute to its potential as a natural remedy for various health issues.
